definitions.meaning: Ọ̄nọ̄dụ̄ nke enweghị ọgụ, esemokwu ma ọ bụ agha; ịdị n’otu na nchekwa.
definitions.meaning_en: Peace, harmony, tranquility; state of quietness or absence of conflict.

examples.igbo: Anyị na-ekpe ekpere maka ùdò n’ala Igbo.
examples.english: We pray for peace in Igboland.

notes: Okwu a na-akpọkarị na ngọzi na ekpere.

definitions.meaning: Kpakpando kacha nso n’ụwa nke na-enye ìhè na okpomọkụ n’ehihie.
definitions.meaning_en: The sun; celestial body that illuminates and warms the earth during the day.

examples.english: The sun is shining brightly today.

etymology: Sitere na 'anya' (eye) + 'anwụ' (sunlight/sky). 'Anya anwụ' (eye of the sky).
notes: N’omenala Igbo, a na-asọpụrụ Anyanwụ dịka chi nke ìhè na ịdị ọcha.

definitions.meaning: Nne, nna, na ụmụaka ma ọ bụ ndị ikwu bi n’otu ebe ma na-elekọta onwe ha.
definitions.meaning_en: Family, household; group of individuals related by blood or marriage living together.

examples.igbo: Ezinụ̄lọ̀ anyị bụ ezinụlọ hụrụ ibe ha n’anya.
examples.english: Our family is a loving family.

notes: Isi mmalite nke obodo na ọdịbendị Igbo.

definitions.meaning: Ebe mmadụ na-azọ ụkwụ; akụkụ ụwa nke akọrọ na-enweghị mmiri.

examples.igbo: Ala Igbo bụ ala na-amị mkpụrụ.

definitions.meaning: Chi nne na-echebe ụkpụrụ na omume ọma n’omenala Igbo.
definitions.meaning_en: Earth goddess; moral deity of fertility and societal ethics in Igbo cosmology.

examples.igbo: Imerụ àlà bụ nnukwu ihe arụ.
examples.english: Desecrating the earth goddess is an abomination.

notes: Olumba dị iche iche na-akpọ ya 'ana' (Anambra) ma ọ bụ 'ani' (Enugu).

definitions.meaning: Ịghọta ihe nke ọma; amamihe na nghọta sitere n’ọmụmụ ma ọ bụ ahụmịhe.

examples.igbo: Ọ́mụ̀mà asụsụ Igbo na-eme ka mmadụ mara omenala ya.
examples.english: Knowledge of the Igbo language enables one to know their culture.

etymology: Sitere na mgbọrọgwụ ngwaa 'ma' (ịma / to know).
notes: Okwu pụtara ihe n’agụmakwụkwọ na mahadum.

definitions.meaning: Ihe e dere ma ọ bụ kọọ gbasara ihe mere n’oge gara aga ma ọ bụ akụkọ ifo.
definitions.meaning_en: Story, tale, history, narration, account of events.

examples.igbo: Nne ochie na-akọrọ anyị àkụ́kọ́ ifo n’abalị ọnwa.
examples.english: Grandmother tells us folktales on moonlit nights.

crossReferences: akụkọ mgbe ochie, akụkọ ifo, ndekọ

definitions.meaning: Akụkụ ahụ mmadụ ma ọ bụ anụmanụ e ji eri nri na ekwu okwu.

examples.igbo: Kpachara anya n’ihe na-esi n’ọ̄nụ̄ gị apụta.
examples.english: Be careful of what comes out of your mouth.

examples.igbo: Ọ̄nụ̄ ngwaahịa a dị oke ọnụ.
examples.english: The price of this commodity is very high.

notes: Nwere ọtụtụ nkọwa dabere n’ahịrịokwu a tụrụ ya.

definitions.meaning: Ụda olu ọma, ịgba na ngwá egwu a haziri nke ọma maka ịnụ ụtọ ma ọ bụ ịgba nkwa.

examples.igbo: Ụmụntakịrị na-agba égwú mgbe a na-akụ ọ́jà.
examples.english: The children are dancing when the flute is being played.

notes: Lezie anya: 'egwù' (grave on ù) pụtara egwu/ụjọ (fear); ebe 'égwú' pụtara egwu/music.

definitions.meaning: Ihe ọ bụla e kere eke nwere ndụ mana o nweghị uche dịka mmadụ (dịka ehi, nkịta, nnụnụ).
definitions.meaning_en: Animal, beast, creature not belonging to humankind.

examples.igbo: Ànụ̄mànụ̀ dị iche iche bi n’ọhịa.
examples.english: Various animals live in the forest.

notes: Gụnyere anụ ọhịa na anụ ụlọ.

definitions.meaning: Usoro na nchịkwa nke ndị isi ji edu obodo ma ọ bụ nzukọ.

examples.english: Righteous leadership brings progress to the community.

etymology: Sitere na ngwaa 'chị' (ịchị / to rule or lead).
crossReferences: onye ndu, eze, ọchịchị onye kwuo uche ya
notes: Okwu dị mkpa na ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị na agụmakwụkwọ.
